**Backend claudecode defaults still list Claude 4.5 models for the OAuth fetch path.** For a new claudecode channel that has OAuth credentials and a flat API key, the model fetch sends the OAuth JSON as `apiKey`. `FetchModels` then returns `claudecode.DefaultModels()`. That list still contains the Claude 4.5 identifiers and no Claude 5.5 identifiers. The frontend quick defaults are updated, but a successful fetch replaces them with this backend list. The picker then shows dated 4.5 models, including `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`, which the PR describes as retiring.
Suggested fix

```diff --- a/llm/transformer/anthropic/claudecode/constants.go +++ b/llm/transformer/anthropic/claudecode/constants.go @@ func DefaultModels() []string { return []string{ - "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001", - "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929", - "claude-opus-4-5-20251101", + "claude-haiku-5-5", + "claude-sonnet-5-5", + "claude-opus-5-5", "claude-opus-4-6", "claude-sonnet-4-6", "claude-opus-4-7", "claude-opus-4-8", } } ```
This patch removes only the three Claude 4.5 entries named in the PR. It keeps the 4.6–4.8 entries because the inspected sources do not show that they are retiring. Remove them too if the intended list is only the three 5.5 models.
